description: This file contains utility functions for file and property handling, including reading property values from files, reading full file content, checking for regular files, recursive file search, and variable expansion within strings. It is part of the Utils namespace and provides inline functions for common file operations and string manipulations.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file based on the property name, supports recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches directories and files based on patterns, with exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Starts recursive search for files from a given input path, with depth and exclusion parameters.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables in an input string by reading property values from a specified file, replacing variables marked with '$'.
